page.overview:
Who is Murphy?

"Murphy never feels like he fits in. Relationships are hard for him, and everyone expects him to be the tough guy, Mr. Muscle, but Murphy's shy. He likes to stay put and prefers the familiar, smooth roads of his old neighborhood. When his best friend invited him to the top destination spa in the country, Murphy reluctantly agreed. Some spa! Until that day, Murphy thought off road was the name of a country band."

Murphy is seen in the ending credits of the film at Sarge's SUV Boot Camp, along with T.J. Hummer, Charlie Cargo and Frank "Pinky" Pinkerton. They are all given an off-road task by Sarge.
